behavior: After bootstrap and before the first IndexPort write, template simulation or an active-index mapping read from real OpenSearch shows observedAt as date; namespace, pod, container, workload, source, and testRunId as keyword; message as text; and the subsequent public IndexPort round trip succeeds through that mapped active index.
rationale: The guarantee spans template installation, concrete-index materialization, and the data-plane adapter; observing the real mapping before a public round trip catches late mapping, dynamic typing, incorrect exact/full-text fields, and an adapter bypassing the bootstrapped index.
